description: Apply a previously fitted DBM mask on the test split instead of re-fitting it: the gate featurizer's file_path loads the fitted theta and the stage comes back in eval mode, so the swap runs through the same hard theta>0 mask the fit was scored on. No train section, hence no train.eval - the number this document saves is a held-out one by construction, which is what dbm.json's own iia.json is NOT (a fit's iia.json is its TRAIN score). No 'entry' selector: dbm.json fits one cell, so its bundle holds a single 'theta' and resolves by slot alone; a swept DBM fit needs one, exactly as weekdays_das_apply.json shows for a rotation. Note the dtype: it is part of the fit's ArtifactIdentity, so an apply document that omits it implies fp32 and is refused [V15] against a bf16 fit - the --dtype flag does not participate.
